notes.title: Release Note 0.2.0
notes.content:
Software CEO – Demo Update v0.2.0



New

Completed the IT management system with the addition of server racks and on-premise servers. You are no longer limited to renting cloud servers, you can manage your own infrastructure.

Objects now lose value over time and can no longer be sold for the same price they were purchased.

Updates

Rebalanced gameplay:

Component creation is faster.

Services generate less revenue overall.

Many over tweaks

Bug Fixes

Various bug fixes and minor improvements.

notes.title: Release Note 0.1.3
notes.content:
Software CEO – Demo Update v0.1.3



New

Added a virtual server rental system: you can now rent cloud servers to keep your online services running.

Multiple server types are available, organized by tier.

Servers are purchased using IT components (no money cost), but require a daily rental fee.

If your servers are overloaded, your services will start losing users.

I strongly recommend starting a new game to fully experience this new system.

Updates

Reduced the speed at which employee computers lose performance by 50%.

Adjusted the user capacity per feature: lower-tier features now bring fewer users, while higher-tier ones bring more. This change rewards investing in advanced features.

The Escape key can now be used to close menus and exit object placement mode.

Bug Fixes

Minor fixes.

Minor performance improvements.

notes.title: Release Note 0.1.2
notes.content:
Software CEO – Demo Update v0.1.2



New

Added the IT role: you can now recruit IT employees to create IT components required for managing your company’s IT infrastructure.

Introduced a performance system for computers: machines degrade over time and must be maintained or repaired using IT components matching their tier.

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where some employee requirement items appeared as “ghost” objects that could not be purchased.

Fixed a bug where modifying an employee’s desk or furniture while in pause mode (without moving the desk) caused the employee to freeze and stop working when resuming the game.

Minor fixes.

Minor performance improvements.
